task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact details, check whether flight CA1234 is on time, and if it is then book an economy seat on that flight for Alice. After that, book a standard room at the Grand Hyatt for Alice from 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-05, then send a high-priority app alert to Alice saying the hotel was booked successfully.
